comments.author: @DiscoveringTheWorld6868
comments.text: As far as I know, windmills weren't just for show; they were once survival machines, using wind power to pump water out of low-lying areas, transforming swamps into farmland and cities.

replies.author: @TheGlobalTruth04
replies.text: Absolutely! Windmills played a crucial role in Dutch history by pumping water out of low-lying land, helping reclaim farmland and protect cities from flooding. Thanks for sharing this great insight!
